item.title: Birmingham warming stations open this weekend in preparation for freezing temperatures
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. (WIAT) -- The city of Birmingham, in partnership with Jimmie Hale Mission, will open its nightly warming station starting this Sunday, Feb. 22.
